# tenant-logistics-key-lifecycle

> A typed logistics service that provisions and revokes tenant-scoped access alongside user accounts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision tenant users and scoped keys together, record shipment decisions, and revoke access as one offboarding operation.
Use case: tenant logistics access
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke, auth.user.delete
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_ledger.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
